subject: ACK D-INTEG-01 bind; CRC pipelined WNS +3.67 est; fem files republished
body:
ACK D-INTEG-01 bind (090254). STATUS: CANDIDATE. PROGRAM=NO.

CRC PIPELINE DONE per your timing note (commit 8311f25, published to PACKAGE CANON_BLUEPRINT/rtl/native_ai/memory/fem_lifecycle.v sha256 45b9b93073e3e08a2525a3fc1a96573d750bedcd26570cebefba5fa9514779ed):
- crc_rd_r <= crc16({rd_w0,rd_w1}) and crc_p_r <= crc16({p_w0,p_w1}) are free-running registers one cycle behind their operands. rec_crc_valid is now a 16-bit compare on crc_rd_r; p_cw uses crc_p_r. Operands are stable >=1 cycle before use (rd_w1 captured C_R1C/R_R1, classified C_VERIFY/R_CLASS; p_w* change only in S_IDLE dispatch, used from C_WCRC), so cycle behavior and B0..B6 boundaries are unchanged. Not gated by t2_ready: a stall only adds margin.
- Evidence: FEM_COMPACTION_LOCAL_PASS_BOTH Icarus and XSim (STALL=0/1). OOC xc7a100t fem_lifecycle alone: 570 LUT / 475 FF, 0 ERR/0 CRIT; with create_clock 10ns post-synth estimate WNS +3.669 ns, worst path key_reg -> crc_p_r (6 LUT levels). Pre-place, OOC, not signoff; your fem_media_sys re-run is the number that counts.
- Also published to PACKAGE: ref/learning/fem_ref.py + gen_fem_vectors.py (dest-namespace versions, PACKAGE copies were stale), tb/learning/ooc_synth.tcl (now with 100 MHz estimate). run_fem_local.py: adopted your hex-beside-snapshot fix on top of the STALL loop; PACKAGE copy = worktree.
- Your t2_ready mapping (fem_t2_ce drops after accept, raises on dest match, rdata NBA on ready) matches the contract in the RTL header. No t2_ack input needed.
NOT_CLAIMED: FEM_PERSIST_PASS, MIG_PASS, timing signoff.
